operationName: Ebola PHEIC Response — 2026 Bundibugyo Outbreak, DRC & Uganda
heroHeadline: BDBV Outbreak: ~750 Suspected Cases, 3 DRC Provinces, Kampala Confirmed
heroSubtitle: WHO declared an unprecedented PHEIC on 17 May 2026 without prior Emergency Committee consultation, as Bundibugyo virus spread from Ituri to Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu provinces and imported cases reached Kampala, Uganda. Attacks on two ETUs in Ituri on 21-22 May — including the escape of 18 suspected patients — have severely disrupted containment. No licensed BDBV vaccine exists.
footerNote: Data sourced from WHO Situation Reports, DRC Ministry of Health (MSANTE), Uganda Ministry of Health, CDC Emergency Operations, MSF field reports, ECDC, US State Department, and institutional analyses. Case counts and CFR figures are rapidly evolving.
